items.title: U.S.’ Oldest Natural History Museum Set to Close This Weekend
items.author: Associated Press
items.content:
<article>The Academy of Natural Sciences of Drexel University—the nation’s oldest natural history museum—will close its doors to the public this weekend. For nearly two centuries, the institution has been a beloved Philadelphia landmark that helped spark generations’ interest in natural science with displays of dinosaur skeletal mounts and plant specimens dating to the Lewis and Clark expedition. (AP Video: Tassanee Vejpongsa)
